title: Worked great --for about four minutes.
text:
Worked great --for about four minutes.. Okay, I ordered this item refurbished to try to save a little money. Never had any problem with refurbs sold on Amazon before. But this vacuum arrived with NO filters in place. It worked wonderfully well during the 4 minutes I used it; after that, there was no more significant suction. Since I assumed it would arrive as originally packaged, I figured the filters were in place and didn't check to make sure. As a result, I may have damaged the motor. Returning it for a refund.

Overall, my impression of the vacuum is good; it was working super well; I'm really disappointed that it didn't last longer. The unit seems a bit rickety when all put together. The ON/OFF button was hit or miss Never got a chance to use the little hand brush attachments, so cannot provide any feedback there.
